summary: This note is a short Wikipedia-style biography of Rodney Buford, a basketball player. It covers his college career at Creighton University, his selection in the 1999 NBA Draft by the Miami Heat, and his subsequent stint in Italy with Basket Rimini before moving through several NBA teams. It closes with his career scoring average.
one_line: Rodney Buford is a former basketball player whose career spanned Creighton, the Miami Heat, Basket Rimini in Italy, and several NBA teams.
key_facts: Rodney Buford played collegiately for Creighton University.
Rodney Buford was selected by the NBA's Miami Heat in the second round (53rd overall) of the 1999 NBA Draft.
Rodney Buford saw limited playing time during his rookie season with the Miami Heat.
Rodney Buford moved to Italy at the start of the season to play for Basket Rimini.
Rodney Buford joined the Philadelphia 76ers in December for the 2000–01 season.
After Philadelphia, Rodney Buford played for the Memphis Grizzlies.
Rodney Buford later played for the Sacramento Kings.
Rodney Buford finished his NBA career with the New Jersey Nets.
Rodney Buford averaged 6.4 points per game in his NBA career.
